primaryQuery: south west wa camping / margaret river camping loop from perth
accuracyFlags: Title/H1 promise a 'loop from Perth' but the route runs Perth-Albany-Esperance and never describes the return leg (~700 km Esperance-Perth).
'Cape to Cape track running 123 kilometres': official WA Parks/Cape to Cape Track materials often cite 135 km; verify and cite.

Cave tickets (Jewel, Lake, Mammoth) 'separately ticketed' and tree-top walk height 40 m: unsourced and may have changed; no WA Parks (DBCA) fee or pass information although the route uses national parks (park entry and camping fees are not mentioned).
Wildflower season 'August to November' is fine but undated; shark advice lacks Surf Life Saving WA / SharkSmart link.
'Valley of the Giants ... near Walpole' correct, but Greens Pool is at William Bay near Denmark and is listed under 'Denmark and Walpole' loosely.
